step1_analysis.circuit_type: Substrate Noise Coupling / Power Distribution Network (PDN) Model
step1_analysis.description: A lumped-element passive RC network modeling the substrate noise coupling from the power supply (VDD) to the substrate in a digital IC. It includes decoupling capacitance and substrate resistances to estimate noise injection.

paper_reference.title: Substrate Noise Generation in Complex Digital Systems: Efficient Modeling and Simulation Methodology and Experimental Verification

Total_Capacitance.description: Low-frequency equivalent capacitance of the power distribution network.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Direct sum of the ideal capacitors in the netlist, representing the total decoupling and parasitic capacitance.

HF_Transfer_Gain.description: High-frequency voltage transfer ratio from VDD to substrate.

sky130_expected.reasoning: At high frequencies, the capacitors act as shorts, and the transfer function is determined by the resistive voltage divider formed by R1 and R2.

Pole_Frequency.description: The 3-dB cutoff frequency of the high-pass transfer function from VDD to substrate.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated from the RC time constant of the series path C1 and (R1+R2). The 3dB point is relative to the high-frequency gain limit.

step3_testbench.description: AC analysis to measure total capacitance, high-frequency transfer gain, and pole frequency of the substrate noise model.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Substrate Noise Model Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* DUT
R1 N1 substrate 0.03
R2 VSS substrate 0.14
C1 VDD N1 1.26n
C2 VDD VSS 2.28n

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 DC 1.8 AC 1
VVSS VSS 0 DC 0

.control
ac dec 100 1k 100G

* Calculate transfer function in dB and total capacitance
let transfer_db = vdb(substrate)
let C_tot = mag(i(VVDD)) / (2 * 3.14159265 * frequency)

* Measure metrics
meas ac Total_Capacitance find C_tot at=10k
meas ac HF_Transfer_Gain find transfer_db at=100G

* Pole frequency is 3dB below the HF gain (-1.68 dB - 3.01 dB = -4.69 dB)
meas ac Pole_Frequency when transfer_db=-4.69 rise=1

print Total_Capacitance HF_Transfer_Gain Pole_Frequency
quit
.endc
.end
